Here's everything we know about the situation, and what could come next.</description><pubDate>Wed, 04 Nov 2026 17:16:12 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1027/r1737056_608x342_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Warriors withholding payments to Porzingis, sources say</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50379460/warriors-not-making-payments-porzingis-sources-say</link><description>The Golden State Warriors are not delivering semimonthly payments to veteran center Kristaps Porzingis on his $20 million salary, league sources told ESPN, ruling that the currently absent center is not rendering his services.</description><pubDate>Wed, 04 Nov 2026 17:19:06 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1012/r1729848_600x400_3-2.jpg" /></item><item><title>NBA Power Rankings: Summing up all 30 teams' starts</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50371604/nba-power-rankings-30-teams-rank-week-two-describe-season</link><description>Here's where all 30 NBA teams rank after two weeks of action, plus the four words used to describe how each team has started the season.</description><pubDate>Wed, 04 Nov 2026 13:48:31 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1103/nba_power_rankings_26_11_04_16x9_608x342.jpg" /></item><item><title>Why Devin Vassell has become a quiet constant for the Spurs</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50371792/san-antonio-spurs-devin-vassell-consistent</link><description>Devin Vassell has quietly evolved into the veteran presence for the San Antonio Spurs.</description><pubDate>Wed, 04 Nov 2026 16:08:21 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1103/r1740644_1296x729_16-9.jpg" /></item></channel></rss>
